source_text: Superhumerale et rationale iudicii — onera populi in umeris, nomina in corde. Pontifex memor ecclesiae.
thought_title: The high priest bears the people on shoulders and heart
orientation: Origen is interpreting the high priest's vestments, specifically the shoulder-piece and the breastpiece of judgment, as figures of the priest's care for the people.
pass_a_gloss: Shoulder-cape and breastplate of judgment — burdens [of the] people on [the] shoulders, names in [the] heart. [The] high priest mindful [of the] church.

choices.why: The literal vestment worn over the shoulders, matching the physical location of the burdens mentioned.
The standard English name for the high priest's breastpiece, preserving the literal sense of judgment.
Literal rendering of the weight carried, keeping the physical metaphor of bearing on the shoulders.
Preserves the adjective 'memor' as a state of remembering, applied to the high priest's ongoing awareness.

pass_b_english: The shoulder-piece and the breastpiece of judgment: the burdens of the people on his shoulders, the names in his heart. The high priest is mindful of the church.
